test_microbatch: test microbatching.microbatch to split batched function evaluations into microbatches with configurable accumulation
test_micro_vmap: test microbatching.micro_vmap as a memory-efficient alternative to jax.vmap with microbatching support
test_micro_grad: test microbatching.micro_grad to compute gradients over microbatches with per-microbatch metrics and auxiliary values

test_calling_conventions: test microbatching with arbitrary calling conventions including positional args, keyword args, and mixed signatures
